summary: XCHG Limited filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release with unaudited first-half 2026 results for the six months ended June 30, 2026. The foreign private issuer reported revenue of $10.27 million versus $12.45 million, gross margin of 38.8% versus 51.3%, an operating loss of $11.18 million, and a net loss of $11.13 million, or $0.004 per Class A and Class B ordinary share. Management cited customer procurement timing and project schedule changes, while guiding full-year 2026 revenue of $32.9-$38.2 million. This is a routine earnings release incorporated by reference; no special-situation transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed.
